note: Capability claims are never trust: src/worker/controller.zig confirmClaim is reached only through applyProbes, which confirms a claim only when the independent violation attempt failed to break it, and removes the claim entirely when the probe succeeded. usableCapabilities returns only confirmed claims, so a policy cannot see an unconfirmed one. Fault evidence: confirming disproved claims makes the case fail (exit 1); revert verified byte-identical with diff. The controller's handshake additionally refuses a worker that presents a session identity different from the authenticated token. Portable case, recorded on windows-x86_64.
authority: self-reported local review, not independent attestation
